title: The Grain That Screams
text: Your farm's harvest screams when it is cut. Not loudly. The reapers have started wearing wax in their ears, and some of them have started to scream back.

options.label: Burn the screaming field, and buy your seed from somewhere sane.

outcomes.text: The field burns quietly, which is worse. Next Year's seed is bought from far away.

options.label: Bring the harvest in anyway. Bread is bread, and winter is coming.

outcomes.text: The bread is fine. Nobody eats it in silence, though.
The bread is fine. One reaper does not stop screaming, and has to be sent away.

options.label: Ask the grain what it wants, and hope it is something you can give.

outcomes.text: It wants to be planted at the Gate. It grows there into something tall, and the Gate's light dims around it.
It wants the one who asked. The Scion sleeps in the field for three nights, and comes back with straw in their lungs.
